author: johan_yang
name: r2-image-uploader
title: R2 Image Uploader
description: Capture screenshots or upload images straight to your Cloudflare R2 bucket and get a link back in your clipboard.

commands.name: capture-and-upload
commands.title: Capture & Upload
commands.description: Screenshot a region, upload it to R2, and copy the link

commands.name: upload-image
commands.title: Upload Image
commands.description: Pick one or more local images to upload to R2

commands.name: upload-finder-selection
commands.title: Upload Finder Selection
commands.description: Upload the images currently selected in Finder

preferences.name: accountId
preferences.title: R2 Account ID
preferences.description: Cloudflare account ID that owns the R2 bucket.

preferences.name: bucket
preferences.title: R2 Bucket
preferences.description: Name of the R2 bucket to upload into.

preferences.name: accessKeyId
preferences.title: R2 Access Key ID
preferences.description: S3 API token access key ID with write access to the bucket.

preferences.name: secretAccessKey
preferences.title: R2 Secret Access Key
preferences.description: S3 API token secret. Stored locally by Raycast, never leaves your machine except to talk to Cloudflare.

preferences.name: publicBaseUrl
preferences.title: Public Base URL
preferences.description: The public URL your bucket is served from, e.g. a custom domain bound to the bucket. No trailing slash.

preferences.name: defaultFormat
preferences.title: Default Copy Format
preferences.description: What gets copied to the clipboard after an upload.
